versions.subject: Add vsls-agent lolbin rule
versions.detection:
selection:
    Image|endswith: '\vsls-agent.exe'
    CommandLine|contains:
        - '--agentExtensionPath' 
filter:
    CommandLine|contains:
        - 'Microsoft.VisualStudio.LiveShare.Agent.'
condition: selection and not filter
